name: Picture
lead: The calls a screen, a canvas and a view all share.

functions.name: clear
functions.description: Its width in pixels: 128 for each map across. Its height in pixels: 128 for each map down. Paints every pixel one colour; black by default. On a view, the default clears it to see-through.

functions.name: set
functions.signature: picture:set(x: number, y: number, color: Ink)
functions.description: Paints one pixel; (0, 0) is the top-left.

functions.name: fill
functions.signature: picture:fill(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, color: Ink)
functions.description: Fills a w by h box of pixels with one colour, its top-left at (x, y).

functions.name: rect
functions.signature: picture:rect(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, color: Ink, radius: number ?)
functions.description: Fills a box like `fill`, with smoothed rounded corners of `radius` pixels when given.

functions.name: circle
functions.signature: picture:circle(x: number, y: number, r: number, color: Ink)
functions.description: Fills a circle of radius `r` pixels around (x, y).

functions.name: text
functions.signature: picture:text(x: number, y: number, text: string, color: Ink, size: number ?) → number
functions.description: Draws text in DejaVu Sans Bold, `size` pixels tall (16 by default), smoothed; returns its width in pixels.

functions.name: measure
functions.description: The width in pixels that `text` would draw, without drawing it; for centring.

functions.name: line
functions.signature: picture:line(x0: number, y0: number, x1: number, y1: number, color: Ink, width: number ?)
functions.description: Draws a smoothed line with round ends, `width` pixels wide (1 by default); positions may be fractions.

functions.name: ring
functions.signature: picture:ring(x: number, y: number, r: number, color: Ink, width: number ?)
functions.description: Draws a circle's outline, `width` pixels wide (1 by default), smoothed.

functions.name: polygon
functions.signature: picture:polygon(points: { { number } | { x: number, y: number } }, color: Ink)
functions.description: Fills a smoothed shape with any number of corners; a point is `{x, y}` or `{ x = .., y = .. }`.

functions.name: gradient
functions.signature: picture:gradient(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, from: Ink, to: Ink, across: string ?)
functions.description: Fills a box that fades from `from` to `to`, top to bottom; `"across"` runs it left to right.

functions.name: sprite
functions.signature: picture:sprite(x: number, y: number, rows: { string }, inks: { [string]: Ink }, scale: number ?)
functions.description: Draws pixel art: each string a row, each character a dot `scale` pixels square (1 by default); a character with no ink is skipped.

functions.name: pixels
functions.signature: picture:pixels(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, data: buffer | string)
functions.description: Writes raw RGB bytes (a buffer or a string), three a pixel, row by row, into a w by h box.

functions.name: draw
functions.signature: picture:draw(source: Screen | Canvas | View, x: number ?, y: number ?)
functions.description: Draws another screen, canvas or view with its top-left at (x, y), skipping its transparent pixels.

functions.name: part
functions.signature: picture:part(col: number, row: number) → { id: number }
functions.description: One map of the picture, `{ id = .. }`, by column and row from (0, 0) top- left; for a hand or a single frame.

functions.name: play
functions.signature: picture:play(opts: { file: string, fps: number ?, loop: boolean ? }) → Video
functions.description: Plays a raw RGB video file from the pack at `fps` 0.5 to 20, the engine drawing each frame; returns the Video.
